name: hebrew-excel-kit
description: Hebrew RTL Excel for AI coding agents: skill, verifier, design system, demo workbook.

optional.pywin32: Windows only. Enables `verify_rtl.py --com`, which checks the file through real Excel.

mcp_servers.notes: First launch downloads and builds the package; warm the cache once or the 30s MCP handshake times out. Use stdio — the HTTP transport binds 0.0.0.0 by default.

skills.name: hebrew-excel-rtl
skills.why: Hebrew RTL Excel: per-sheet RTL, reading order, Israeli formats, manager-readable design, per-sheet self-check. Nothing equivalent exists on any marketplace.

skills.name: spreadsheet
skills.claude_code_install: npx -y skills add davila7/claude-code-templates --skill spreadsheet --agent claude-code
skills.why: openpyxl/pandas conventions and investment-banking formatting discipline.

skills.name: inventory-manager
skills.claude_code_install: npx -y skills add jmsktm/claude-settings --skill "Inventory Manager" --agent claude-code
skills.why: Reorder points, safety stock, demand forecasting, ABC classification.

skills.name: audit-xls
skills.claude_code_install: claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/financial-services && claude plugin install model-builder@claude-for-financial-services
skills.why: Formula tracing, hardcode detection, balance checks on an inherited workbook. First-party Anthropic.

install_targets.claude-desktop: Settings > Capabilities > Skills — ZIP upload, one per skill
